review_comments.body: **State removal lacks direct tests** These tests call only the client getters, so they would still pass if either new `Read` state-removal branch were missing. Add resource-level tests for both permission versions that check a 404 clears state without errors and a 403 leaves state intact. This would catch a return of the failed Terraform plans this change fixes. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
